name: app_temps
why: Python 3.12+ sum() over floats uses compensated (Neumaier) summation; Limits sum() adds left to right
fix: Python side accumulates with a plain loop

name: app_bst

fix: rewrote contains() as a loop that matches on the Option child index

name: app_dijkstra

fix: bind a typed empty list first: let no_edges: [Edge] = []

name: app_dijkstra
